title: Can Artificial Intelligence Help Sweden Predict Disasters and Protect Its Critical Services?
description: A World Bank report warns that fragmented disaster data, weak coordination and funding gaps are limiting Sweden’s ability to prepare for floods, wildfires, landslides and emerging security threats.
